title: Scaffold repo (TS/ESM/pnpm, lint, validate, CI wiring)
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). Before any lesson can be authored or validated the repository needs a working TypeScript/ESM/pnpm workspace with lint, schema validation CI, and the correctness-gate CI wiring in place. This is the prerequisite for every other task that delivers a PR.
objective: Set up the repository's TypeScript/ESM/pnpm workspace, linting configuration, AJV schema validation script, and CI pipeline so that pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass on an empty but correctly structured repo.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository uses TypeScript, ESM modules, and pnpm workspaces; package.json scripts are defined for build, test, and lint.
A lint configuration (ESLint or equivalent) is committed and passes on the scaffolded code.
An AJV-based schema validation script is wired into CI and runs on every PR.
CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent) runs pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint on every push and PR; the pipeline file is committed.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint all pass on the scaffolded repo with no content yet.
Directory structure matches the authoring format decided in occ-decide-000.
Maintainer reviews and approves before merge.
output: A merged PR adding the complete repository scaffold: pnpm workspace config, TypeScript setup, lint config, AJV validation script, and CI pipeline configuration.
